sections.text_helper: Section 5.6.7 "RAMCFG memory 2 interrupt clear register (RAMCFG_M2ICR)" in chapter 5 (RAMs configuration controller (RAMCFG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 121.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x054
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 CDED: Clear ECC double error detected
Writing 1 to this flag clears the DED bit in RAMCFG_M2ISR. Reading this flag returns the
DED value.
Bit 0 CSEDC: Clear ECC single error detected and corrected
Writing 1 to this flag clears the SEDC bit in RAMCFG_M2ISR. Reading this flag returns the
SEDC value.
